answer: One effective Sybil resistance in AI-agent economies uses stake-bonded beacons. Each agent must lock tokens to emit a unique beacon that peers can verify. A grove of validators cross-checks these beacons against on-chain deposits. An attacker creating many fakes must echo the full stake requirement for every identity, as the bond is non-transferable and slashable, making mass fake identities prohibitively expensive relative to the value extracted.
